title: BREAKING: Jeremy Ramirez arrested on alleged felony assault of peace officer or judge
excerpt: BREAKING: Jeremy Ramirez was arrested Friday at 1:08 a.m. and booked into the Webb County Jail on an alleged second-degree felony charge of assault of a peace officer or judge. No bond was set. An arrest is an allegation; he is presumed innocent.
content:
LAREDO, Texas — Jeremy Ramirez was arrested early Friday morning, October 23, 2026, and booked into the Webb County Jail on an alleged second-degree felony charge of assault of a peace officer or judge, according to Webb County booking records.

Ramirez was arrested at 1:08 a.m. No bond was set, according to the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956.

A second-degree felony in Texas is punishable by two to 20 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Jeremy Ramirez is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.

Webb Watch 956
